scope: Historical circa1934 original Cremorne Theatre on Stanley Street: complete theatre hall/tall louvred upper envelope and roof, lower street-front entrance annex/canopy, own scalloped/stepped entrance parapet and multi-light timber doors. Reconstruct a bounded exterior with honest hidden side/rear/roof estimates. The original burned in1954 and is not the modern QPAC namesake. Exclude surrounding street, adjoining businesses/structures, people, text lettering/posters and interior.

The visible building has a tall lightly sloped roof envelope, very large continuous upper louvred bands on both visible elevations, lower louvres/canvas-like wall panels, low projecting entrance annex/parapet/canopy, gridded timber doors and two tiny pointed vents. Monochrome image cannot establish original color; do not invent a brightly colored facade. Other attribution/poster/performer/interior imagery unused.
